startupRestore.page.title: Startup & Restore
startupRestore.page.subtitle: Save the apps, folders and browser pages that are open now as a work profile; after sign-in it can be restored one by one in plan order.

startupRestore.tip.captureCurrent.name: Save Current Plan
startupRestore.tip.captureCurrent.descri: Save the open apps, folders and pages as a new plan.
startupRestore.tip.captureCurrent.sugges: Existing plans are not overwritten. Browser tabs may switch briefly to read full URLs; minimized windows stay minimized.
startupRestore.tip.restoreNow.name: Restore Now
startupRestore.tip.restoreNow.descriptio: Restore the current plan item by item.
startupRestore.tip.restoreNow.suggestion: It first counts down "wait before start (seconds)" (0 starts immediately). You can click "Cancel Restore" on the card while waiting or restoring.
startupRestore.tip.search.name: Search Plans
startupRestore.tip.search.description: Find existing work profiles by name or save time.
startupRestore.tip.search.suggestion: Click a result to switch to it; separate words with spaces; check "Search by time too" to enter only a time (for example 15m).
startupRestore.tip.appendTime.name: Append Current Time
startupRestore.tip.appendTime.descriptio: Append "time zone + current time" to the current plan name.
startupRestore.tip.appendTime.suggestion: For example WorkProfile_Beijing time 2026/9/24 1:52; click again to update only the time; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
startupRestore.tip.dropPadBottom.name: End-of-list drop zone
startupRestore.tip.dropPadBottom.descrip: Drag an item or plan onto this blank area and release to move it to the end of the list.
startupRestore.tip.dropPadBottom.suggest: Hold to keep the list scrolling down.
startupRestore.tip.dropPadTop.name: Start-of-list drop zone
startupRestore.tip.dropPadTop.descriptio: Drag an item onto this blank area and release to move it to the front of the list.
startupRestore.tip.dropPadTop.suggestion: Hold to keep the list scrolling up.
startupRestore.tip.profileExpand.name: Expand or collapse plan
startupRestore.tip.profileExpand.descrip: Show or hide this work profile's startup items.
startupRestore.tip.profileSave.name: Save Current Plan
startupRestore.tip.profileSave.descripti: Save the open apps, folders and pages into this work profile again (replacing its current list).
startupRestore.tip.profileRestore.name: Restore This Plan
startupRestore.tip.profileRestore.descri: Start this work profile's items in order.
startupRestore.tip.profileDelete.name: Delete Plan
startupRestore.tip.profileDelete.descrip: Delete this work profile folder and its startup list (restorable from the Recycle Bin).
startupRestore.tip.profileMove.name: Hold to Move
startupRestore.tip.profileMove.descripti: Hold and drag here to reorder work profiles; drop onto the middle of another card to merge into that plan.
startupRestore.tip.folderCannotSave.name: Plan folders cannot store a startup list
startupRestore.tip.folderCannotSave.desc: A plain folder only holds child plans; select a child plan inside it to save startup items.
startupRestore.tip.profileNamePlain.desc: Double-click to rename (Enter confirms, Esc cancels); click to switch the current plan; drag the title to reorder plans.
startupRestore.tip.itemEnable.name: Start this item
startupRestore.tip.itemEnable.descriptio: Unchecking skips this item during restore but keeps it in the plan.
startupRestore.tip.itemGrip.name: Hold to drag and reorder
startupRestore.tip.itemGrip.description: Hold and drag to change the startup order.
startupRestore.tip.itemGrip.suggestion: You can also hold Shift and drag anywhere on the row.
startupRestore.tip.itemDelete.name: Delete startup item
startupRestore.tip.itemDelete.descriptio: Remove this item from this work profile.
